title: Database CRDT sources alerts requests
summary: Conflict-free replicated data type (CRDT) source alert requests

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| [GET](#get-all-bdbs-crdt-sources-alerts) | `/v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts` | Get all CRDT sources alert states for all CRDB databases |
| [GET](#get-bdbs-crdt-sources-alerts) | `/v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts/{uid}` | Get all CRDT sources alert states for a database |
| [GET](#get-bdbs-crdt-source-all-alerts) | `/v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts/{uid}/{crdt_src_id}` | Get all alert states for a CRDT source |
| [GET](#get-bdbs-crdt-source-alert) | `/v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts/{uid}/{crdt_src_id}/{alert}` | Get a database alert state |

sections.title: Get all CRDB CRDT source alert states
sections.text:
GET /v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts

Get all alert states for all CRDT sources of all CRDBs.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_all_bdbs_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_all_bdbs_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a hash of alert UIDs and the [alerts states](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert) for each local BDB of CRDB.

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Get all BDB CRDT sources alert states
sections.text:
GET /v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts/{int: uid}

Get all alert states for all crdt sources for a specific local bdb of a CRDB.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_bdb_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_bdb_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts/1 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | The unique ID of the database |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a hash of [alert objects](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert) and their states.

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | No error |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | Specified bdb does not exist |

sections.title: Get all CRDT source alert states
sections.text:
GET /v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts/{int: uid}/{int: crdt_src_id}

Get all alert states for specific crdt source for a specific local BDB
of a CRDB.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_bdb_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_bdb_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts/1/2 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | The unique ID of the database |
| crdt_src_id | integer | The ID of the crdt source in this BDB |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns a hash of [alert objects](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert) and their states. 

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | No error |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | Specified bdb does not exist |

sections.title: Get database alert state
sections.text:
GET /v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts/{int: uid}/{int: crdt_src_id}/{alert}

Get a BDB alert state.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_bdb_alerts](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_bdb_alerts) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/bdbs/crdt_sources/alerts/1/2/crdt_src_syncer_connection_error 

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |


#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | The unique ID of the database |
| crdt_src_id | integer | The ID of the crdt source in this BDB |
| alert | string | The alert name |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns an [alert object](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/alert).

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | No error |
| [400 Bad Request](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.1) | Bad request |
| [404 Not Found](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.5) | Specified alert or bdb does not exist |
